column3: title card: Part II, friendly operations; lens is opt-in, off = legacy twin (ERP_FRIENDLY_OPS_LENS.md §15-16)
column4: F: 第二部分,便捷操作。
column5: F: 制造,第二部分:便捷操作。 | M: 这是孪生系统上一个可选的便捷视图。关闭时,每个界面都和 iDempiere 一样。打开时,同样的工作步骤更少,账目结果相同。
column7: F: Manufacturing, part two: friendly operations. | M: An optional lens on the twin. Switched off, every screen stays as in iDempiere. Switched on, the same work takes fewer steps, and the books come out the same.

column4: M: 便捷视图是一个插件。
column5: M: 便捷视图和其他插件一样。 | F: 我们从插件面板安装它。它立即启动,只注册了一样东西:这个视图。
column6: M: The lens is a plugin.
column7: M: The lens is a plugin like any other. | F: We install it from the Plugins panel. It starts at once and registers one thing: the lens.

column3: card: gestures Odoo 8 (mo_produceall_woodpanel log) · twin 21 · lens 18 (ERP_FRIENDLY_OPS_LENS.md §14.1, §15.1)
column4: F: 是数出来的,不是猜的。
column5: F: 我们数了一张制造订单的步骤,从空白表单到成品入库。 | M: Odoo 十七需要八步。孪生系统的普通界面需要二十一步。加上便捷视图,十八步。 | F: 剩下的差距主要在订单抬头,孪生系统沿用原系统的默认值。
column7: F: We counted the steps for one manufacturing order, from an empty form to finished goods. | M: Odoo seventeen needs eight. The twin's plain screens need twenty-one. With the lens, eighteen. | F: Most of what remains is the order header, where the twin follows legacy defaults.

column3: §ERP_FILM_FACT preview.ok.panel: Manufacturing Order BOM 1 new · BOM Line 2 new · Material Requirement Planning 3 new · §SAVE-PREVIEW ok=Y ops=10 (nothing committed) · pp_order=18 unchanged
column5: M: 一张新订单。在原系统里,组件要保存后才出现。 | F: 预览运行的是同一个保存过程,但什么都不留下。 | M: 一个订单物料清单,两条组件行,三条计划行。数据库里仍然没有新订单。
column7: M: A new order. In legacy, its components appear only after Save. | F: Preview runs the very same save, and keeps nothing. | M: One order BOM, two component lines, three planning rows. And still no new order in the database.

column3: §ERP_FILM_FACT preview.refused.panel: BOMExpired PP_Product_BOM 50005 not valid at 2007-01-01 (from 2007-09-22)
column5: F: 现在把开始日期改到物料清单生效之前。 | M: 预览显示保存时会给出的拒绝:这个物料清单在二〇〇七年九月二十二日之前无效。 | F: 什么都没有写入。我们把日期改回来。
column7: F: Now a start date before the bill of materials is valid. | M: Preview shows the refusal Save would give: the BOM is not valid before twenty-second September two thousand seven. | F: Nothing was written. We put the date back.

column3: §ERP_FILM_FACT lens.saveComplete documentno=80000 docstatus=CO · §OPS-LENS docAction=CO from=DR to=CO
column5: M: 保存并完成,只需一次点击。 | F: 它先保存再完成,走的是工具栏和操作栏的同样两步。订单八万已完成。
column7: M: Save and Complete is one click. | F: It saves, then completes, through the same two steps as the toolbar and the action bar. Order eighty thousand is complete.

column3: §ERP_FILM_FACT form.preset=80000 · form.message=3 cost collector(s) completed: Issue 7000, Issue 100, Receipt 100 · commit ops=121 verifyChain=ok
column5: F: 订单现在提供自己的收货与发料,订单已经选好。 | M: 点一次处理:两次组件发料,加上一百件成品收货,在一个事务里完成。
column7: F: The order now offers its own Receipt and Issue, with the order already chosen. | M: One Process: two component issues and the receipt of one hundred units, completed in one transaction.

column3: §ERP_FILM_FACT lens.related Cost Collector (3) tipCollectors=3 · collectors.grid=3 rows
column5: M: 回到订单,便捷视图显示与它关联的内容和数量。 | F: 成本归集,三条。点一下,正好列出这三张单据。
column7: M: Back on the order, the lens shows what is linked to it, with a count. | F: Cost Collector, three. One click lists exactly those three documents.

column3: card: W-FRIENDLY-OPS read from its log: F2 events equal, F3 events equal, F6 preview rows == save rows, F7 nothing written, F9 refusal == Save
column5: F: 点击更少,结果不能不同。 | M: 见证程序把每个便捷操作和普通操作并排运行。保存并完成触发了同样的一百二十九个模型事件,顺序相同。收货与发料,同样的九十九个。 | F: 预览显示的十行,正是保存后写入的十行,预览本身什么都没写。
column7: F: Fewer clicks must not mean a different result. | M: A witness ran each lens action next to the plain one. Save and Complete fired the same one hundred twenty-nine model events, in the same order. The Receipt and Issue, the same ninety-nine. | F: Preview showed the ten rows Save then wrote, and wrote nothing itself.

column3: §ERP_FILM_FACT lens.afterStop lenses=0 status=Resolved · plain.toolbar lensBar=0 order 80000 CO
column5: M: 停止便捷视图,同一张订单回到普通的 iDempiere 工具栏。 | F: 单据都还在,只是快捷方式没了。
column7: M: Stop the lens, and the same order is back on the plain iDempiere toolbar. | F: The documents stay. Only the shortcuts are gone.
